children: SoSoValue data showed that HYPE spot ETFs recorded a total net outflow of $1.58 million on September 23, U.S. Eastern Time. According to Odaily, only Bitwise Hyperliquid ETF (BHYP) posted a net outflow for the day, totaling $1.58 million, while its cumulative historical net inflow reached $144 million.
As of press time, HYPE spot ETFs had total net assets of $505 million, a HYPE net asset ratio of 2.45%, and cumulative historical net inflows of $334 million.

title: HYPE Spot ETFs Record $1.58 Million Net Outflow on September 23
